custom_data.job_description:
We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving real customer problems by combining software engineering with customer-facing solution design. As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Hunar.AI, you will work closely with enterprise customers to understand their hiring and workforce workflows, design AI-powered solutions, build integrations, configure conversational AI agents, and deploy solutions successfully. This is an ideal role for graduates who enjoy working across engineering, product, and customers. 
Core Responsibilities 
• Understand customer business workflows and operational challenges. • Translate ambiguous customer requirements into well-defined engineering tasks. • Map operational problems into scalable AI-powered solutions. • Build integrations and workflows from scratch. • Configure and deploy Hunar.AI’s proprietary conversational AI agents. • Design prompts, workflows, and multi-agent automations. • Build analytics dashboards and reporting views. • Conduct solution workshops with HR, Operations, and Engineering teams. • Travel to customer locations across India for enterprise deployments. • Work closely with Enterprise Sales, Product Management, and Customer Success throughout implementation. 
Solution Areas You will design and deploy solutions across: 
• Voice AI APIs • Prompt Engineering • WhatsApp-based workflows • Analytics Dashboards • Scheduling Systems • Multi-Agent Workflows
Technical Skills You should be comfortable with: 
• Python, Node.js, or Java • REST APIs • SQL • Cloud platforms (GCP or AWS) • React.js and Next.js • TypeScript • Vite and modern frontend tooling • Experience deploying applications using Vercel • Strong understanding of GitHub workflows, including creating and reviewing Pull Requests • Ability to write production-ready, maintainable, and scalable code • Familiarity with secure coding practices and building solutions that adhere to our security and compliance standards 
Who Should Apply 
• 0.5 – 3 years of experience as a software engineer, solutions engineer, or in a similar customer-facing technical role. • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work through ambiguity. • Comfort working directly with customers, including on-site at their offices. • Willingness to travel across India for enterprise deployments.
